notes: May have had early build that was abandoned, but did not make it far if so. N1 predated a day or so before fledgling. F left immediately, wandered for a few days, then set up with a new male ~600m SW. Successfully fledged all from that nest.

N1 failed late incubation, but F bailed. She was detected the day found failed ~200m away while the male remained in the nest clearing, but she could not be relocated in subsequent days. Not in 11D and surrounding area, and not detected on any late season systematics.
N1 failed late nestling stage, and F left immediately. Pinged once during late-season systematics in 05C, but could not be refound. Tag signal rather was rather weak even early season.
Fledged first nest. They were small at nestling banding and remained in the nest for another full day before fledging.

N1 failed after National Guard drove trucks all over and camped within 30ft for weeks on end. F renested nearby, failed quickly, and left while male remained. She was detected once ~1100m S foraging in dense woods and then not refound subsequently. Unknown number of eggs in N2.
Likely had prior nest attempt that we did not find. N1 predated shortly after hatching, perhaps by BLJA with fledglings in clearing. F left after N1 failure and was not detected again.

Caught with leaf during building. Assumed first nest in area of capture, but did not find. Failed nest later found (N08C260401 on FM), and then first actual active nest slightly south. Very poor placement, highly exposed, lost several eggs along the way but 1n hatched briefly. F left post failure and was not redetected.
Fledged first nest. Lost nestlings rapidly and only fledged two.

N1 failed during incubation, N2 failed during incubation, then F left. Spent a few days deep in the woods, then settled on an area 200-300m WSW of original spot. Foraged for many days in wet willowy edge with no sign of renesting.

Unfound first nest was driven over by the National Guard. N1 (the renest) failed, then F spent several days in area before leaving incrementally. Refound 9 days after disappearing 5.5km S. Stuck in that spot for many days with no renesting activity, appeared to be molting.
N1 and N2 failed during incubation. N3 successful. Assume same male, but was UB at first two so not positive.
N1 failed mid nestling stage, F disappeared. Not detected in area or on late season systematics.
N1 failed during incubation. F then moved ~750m NNE while male remained. She acted nesty in three different areas and associated with a new male but never actually did anything.
